name: camayoc-delivery-emitter-catalog
episode_body: Supported source adapters, not an installation manifest or runtime coverage claim. Each adapter uses the same CDEvents mapping and governed ingress. Deployment adapters have success and failure fixtures; the lifecycle emitter has CI outcome and native review controls. DORA queries require recorded deployment and change coverage; publishing this catalog does not arm a producer.

nodes.name: camayoc-emitter-actions
nodes.description: GitHub / Forgejo Actions adapter support in Camayoc. Source support is separate from runtime activation and measured event coverage.

properties.emitterHow: Reusable deployment-event action or CLI; skipped and cancelled jobs emit no deployment.

nodes.name: camayoc-emitter-ansible
nodes.description: Ansible adapter support in Camayoc. Source support is separate from runtime activation and measured event coverage.

properties.emitterHow: Callback writes one event per applied host; failed or unreachable recap counters mean failure.

nodes.name: camayoc-emitter-terraform
nodes.description: Terraform adapter support in Camayoc. Source support is separate from runtime activation and measured event coverage.

properties.emitterHow: Wrap an actual apply -json; errors or a nonzero exit after an attempted change mean failure.

nodes.name: camayoc-emitter-native
nodes.description: Native CDEvents adapter support in Camayoc. Source support is separate from runtime activation and measured event coverage.

properties.emitterHow: Pass supported CDEvents through the single governed ingress; unknown types are quarantined.

nodes.name: camayoc-emitter-github-changes
nodes.description: GitHub change lifecycle adapter support in Camayoc. Source support is separate from runtime activation and measured event coverage.

properties.emitterHow: Read change, CI and native review records into ChangeEvent history; scheduling is separate.
